caption: The drawing depicts an antique sewing machine placed on a rectangular, brown wooden tabletop. The sewing machine is black with ornate metalwork details and is mounted on the right side of the table. The table is supported by two black, cast iron legs with intricate, looping decorative patterns. Between the legs at the bottom, there is a pedal mechanism connected by a wooden rod that runs diagonally upward to the sewing machine, also featuring ornate ironwork. The whole composition is centered on a plain, off-white background with a thin rectangular border around the central image. There are no other objects or elements depicted in the drawing.
title: Sewing Machine
